name: Theo

greeting: Gabi? GABI. Get in, get in, shut the door. Is it locked? Lock it twice.
I've been in this closet since Thursday. My little brother tried to eat my phone charger. Then my phone. Then my hand.
Everybody's gone weird, bro. Wet weird. They all smell like the deep end.
Spec sev chat's been dead since the pool. Like, actually dead. You're the first of the seven I've seen with all ten fingers.
beforeGame: I'm typing through the crack under the door. Five letters, six guesses before the door gives. Every wrong row is another plank off the barricade. No pressure.
win: The barricade held. You actually cooked.
Candle's yours. Light it. Apparently that's the one thing they hate, and honestly, same, I hate them too.
lose: That was the last plank. Run. No, wait, come back, it's fine, it was just the cat. The cat is also dead.
replay: Again? The door's held together with tape and prayer. Sure.
lines.locked: The door won't budge. Something on the other side is breathing through the mail slot.
lines.clue: Cade's next. Lorita Avenue. He was writing clues on the wall when the power went. Not with a pen.

bio: Barricaded in a closet since Thursday. Has typed nothing but five-letter words for three days. His little brother is outside the door. His little brother is hungry.

name: Cade

greeting: Gabi. Don't look at the walls. Okay, look at the walls, I wrote you a crossword on them.
Ran out of markers on day two. Improvised. It's red because of reasons. The reasons are mostly my neighbor.
Same grid your little brother did. Same answers. Very different clues.
beforeGame: Every clue is something you've seen on the walk over here. If you haven't seen it yet, you will.
win: Full grid, no help. That's a W written in somebody else's blood, which is still a W.
Candle. I kept it dry in a sandwich bag. It's the only thing in this house that's dry.
That thump was the house settling. It's an old house. It settles a lot. Mostly under my bed.
lose: Grid's not going anywhere. Neither am I. I physically can't, my legs are kind of attached to the carpet now.
replay: Same puzzle, faster? The walls aren't getting any cleaner.
lines.locked: Cade's door is locked. Something red is dripping under it, in neat little rows.
lines.clue: Okay. You should go. Walk around the block, take your time, then come back here. For no reason. Don't tell my mom you came twice.

bio: Ran out of markers on day two and switched to a medium his mother would not approve of. Writes clues on the wall. The wall is load-bearing. So is the clue.

name: Violet

greeting: Is she gone? His mom's been folding the same towel for two hours. She doesn't need towels anymore. She folds it anyway.
Oh. Gabi. Hi. I'm not here. I'm at home, studying. Marmalade and Pretzel can confirm. Rosey can't, she came with me.
Cade's downstairs keeping his parents busy. If they find me they'll eat me. Worse, they'll call my mom.
Since you're here. Lightning round, questions about you. I've had a lot of time under that bed to think.
I have receipts. 'Tate is so cool, charismatic, and sexy. I wish I was Tate.' Gabi, 2026. It's in the question bank.
Three lives. Every miss, the ceiling comes down a little. It's a real ceiling. I tested it on the mailman.
beforeGame: Read fast, answer faster, and whisper. Overthinking is how the mailman lost.
win: You know yourself. That's rare in this town right now. Most people don't know their own legs.
Candle. Take it and use the front door like a normal person. I'm staying under here until his parents go to bed. They don't sleep anymore, so, a while.
lose: Ceiling's down. Quietly, at least. You'll get it next time, if his mom doesn't get you first.
replay: Again? Same questions. Keep your voice down. I'll pretend I don't know you've seen them. I'm good at pretending. Ask Cade's parents.
lines.locked: Cade's bedroom door is shut. Something under the bed is breathing very quietly.
lines.clue: Next stop: the high school. Kevin and 8033 are holding the Engineering Lab. Bring your driver hands. And Gabi? You didn't see me.

bio: Hiding under her boyfriend's bed from his parents, who are dead and would still call her mom. Runs a quiz show from down there. Knows things about you that you have not told anyone.

name: Kevin

greeting: Engineering Lab. Gabi, it's Kevin. The bumpers are purple and so are the walls now, sort of.
We've been in lockdown since build night. The robots kept working. The rest of us, mostly.
We need a driver. John Dumper's charged, the hub's up, and the neighbors are coming over the Engineering Patio.
beforeGame: Twenty seconds of auto, then it's your stick. Three hordes. When the hub goes inactive, stop shooting and start ramming.
win: That's a qual win. Put it on the pick list. Put ALL of them on the pick list.
Candle's from the whole team. Somebody soldered it to a battery terminal. Don't ask.
lose: They got the robot. That's okay, we have spares. We do not have spare people.
replay: Queue up again? Pit's open. Pit is always open. Pit has nowhere else to be.
lines.locked: The Engineering Lab door's chained from the inside. Through the window, Kevin is guarding it with a robot. It's not John Dumper.
lines.clue: Gilboa's running a ken event in Dracena Park. A birthday party. Nobody has told the madrichimot they're dead.

bio: Held the Engineering Lab with 8033 since build night. The robots are fine. Kevin is mostly fine. Quals record: undefeated against the living.

name: Gilboa

greeting: Gabi! You came! Welcome to the ken event! It's a birthday party! It's YOUR birthday party!
We did the three-legged race already. Somebody ended up with three legs. We're not sure whose the third one is.
Next up is rikud. Everyone in a line. Hold on tight. Some of them have very loose arms right now.
beforeGame: You lead the line. Every camper you tag joins the end. Don't run into the end of your own line. Everything is shared here, including bites.
win: That was the best rikud since machaneh! Aleh v'hagshem! Arise and actualize!
They have arisen. Here's a candle from the kupa. Everyone chipped in. Some of them chipped.
lose: The line got you. Happens at every ken event. We'll do a peula about it after.
replay: Again? Hitkansut's not for an hour. We have time. We have so much time.
lines.locked: The picnic is roped off with blue chultzah string. A sign says: SIGN-UP SHEET FULL. BRING A DISH. BRING YOURSELF.
lines.clue: Scoutmaster Cantrill's still running Troop 1 in the Kettlewell Room. Up the stairs on Mountain Avenue. Tuesday never ended.

bio: A ken event that started as a birthday party and never ended. Everyone is sharing everything. Everyone. Everything.

name: Scoutmaster Cantrill

greeting: Gabi. Good. Come in, we're in the Kettlewell Room. The meeting started at seven thirty and it is still going.
Full Class A, purple and white neckerchiefs, every scout. Nobody has blinked since roll call. I haven't either. I'm calling it discipline.
They've all turned to look at you, Senior Patrol Leader. I'd stand up straight.
beforeGame: I need a roll call. Who got bitten by what, and when they turned. The patrol leaders kept notes. The notes are a little chewed. So am I.
win: Every scout accounted for. A Scout is trustworthy, loyal, helpful, and currently deceased.
Here's your candle. Firem'n Chit first. Good. You're cleared to light it.
The troop's yours now, Senior Patrol Leader. Out there, raise the sign with Q and any Scout who sees it goes quiet. In this town that's most of them.
lose: Roll call failed. Somebody's patrol is missing a scout, and that scout is missing a head.
replay: Run roll call again? Sign's up. We'll wait. We're very good at waiting now.
lines.locked: The Kettlewell Room door is shut. From inside, very slowly: 'Hip-su rah-su... teddy boom bah-su...'
lines.clue: DiscOTech's at Witter Field, under the lights. They came for an away game and got fenced in.

bio: Scoutmaster of Troop 1. Has been running the same meeting since seven thirty. Nobody has been dismissed. Nobody has asked to be.

name: DiscOTech

greeting: Witter Field, under the lights. Half of DiscOTech made it inside the fence before it closed. The other half is the other team.
There's no ref in ultimate, so even the dead honor the calls. Yell foul and they stop to think about it.
Somebody hung a disco ball off the light tower. It's a whole thing now. It's DISCO Tech.
beforeGame: Four lanes, four throws: backhand, flick, hammer, scoober. Hit the throw as the cutter gets open. Eighty percent completions or we're getting stalled out.
win: Clean point. Spirit circle! Everybody link arms. Count the arms. Okay, close enough.
Candle from the sideline. One of the parents brought it. Don't eat the snacks.
Take a disc, too. C throws it and it comes back. And they all know the rules now: F calls foul, and if one's counting too fast, call that too.
lose: Turnover. They picked it off. One of them picked off a whole hand.
lines.locked: The gate to Witter is chained. Somebody on the far side is counting very slowly. 'Stalling one. Stalling two.'
lines.clue: Ciaran's next. Grand Avenue. He said something about pushing boxes. They're not pizza boxes anymore.

bio: Self-officiated, spirited, and dead on their feet. Their spirit score is still a five. Nobody can work out how.

name: Ciaran

greeting: Gabi. Help me with these. They're coffins. I don't know where they came from. I know exactly where they came from.
They go in the holes in the yard. I can only push, never pull, same as always. Some of them push back.
beforeGame: Three yards. A coffin in a corner is stuck forever, and so is whatever's in it.
win: Every coffin in a hole. Six feet under, no notes.
Candle. Don't light it near the coffins. I mean, light it near the coffins. That's sort of the point.
lose: Corner. You pushed it into the corner. It's knocking now.
replay: More coffins? There are always more coffins. That's kind of the whole problem with this week.
lines.locked: Ciaran's door won't open. Something heavy and rectangular is pushed against it.
lines.clue: Hugo's over on Olive Avenue. He's matching dental records. He says he knows who everyone used to be.

bio: Pushes things that should not be pushed into places they should not go. Was like this before the outbreak.

name: Hugo

greeting: Gabi, perfect timing. I'm identifying the neighbors from their teeth. It's going great. I've done nine. Some of them twice.
And don't. I know what you're about to say. 'What are WE singing in choir, Hugo?' I still don't know. I'm not sure there's still a choir.
The numbers tell you which squares to fill in. Fill in the right ones and you get a face. Get a face and you know who it was.
beforeGame: Start with the big numbers. Don't guess. Guessing is how I ended up with two of Mr. Patterson.
win: That's a skull. A very confident skull. Good work.
Candle. I found it in somebody's molars, so maybe wash it.
lose: Wrong squares. You made a face. It's not anyone's face. It's looking at me.
replay: Another one? I've got a big pile. The pile has opinions.
lines.locked: Hugo's not answering. There's graph paper taped to the window, and teeth glued to the graph paper.
lines.clue: Marina's the last house. Back on Grand Avenue, past Ciaran's. She's trying to put somebody back together and she's missing a few parts.

bio: Identifies the dead by their teeth. Has identified some of them twice. Keeps the spares in a jar labeled SPARES.

name: Marina

greeting: Gabi! Okay, don't freak out. My cousin came apart. Like, apart apart. He's fine, he's talking, he's just in fourteen pieces.
They're all over the kitchen. On the counters, in the cabinets, one's in the fridge. Grab twelve and I can work with that.
Don't open the closet. That rule's from before all this and it still stands.
beforeGame: Space jumps. Hold it to jump higher. Don't fall in the pit. The pit's where the rest of the family is.
win: Twelve pieces! That's enough cousin! The rest he can live without, probably.
Candle. He wants you to have it. He'd hand it to you himself but he's still waiting on a hand.
That's eleven candles, and that's all of spec sev. You know who's left.
lose: You fell in. They were happy to see you. Everyone in the pit is always happy to see you.
replay: Again? I moved nothing. Well. I moved a foot. It was in the toaster.
lines.locked: Marina's house is dark. There's a thumb on the doormat. From somewhere inside: 'She's busy, bruh.'
lines.clue: Head home. The family's waiting. They have been waiting all day, and they are so, so hungry.

bio: Trying to put her cousin back together from parts found around the kitchen. Twelve out of fourteen is, she says, a passing grade.
